SELECT * FROM modules ORDER BY id

WITH RECURSIVE module_closure(module_id) AS (
  -- modules that directly depend on the retired package
  SELECT subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_package
  WHERE object_id = (
    SELECT object_id FROM task_retires_package WHERE subject_id = 'task:fx01-cutover'
  )
  UNION
  -- modules that depend on those modules (reverse: find dependents)
  SELECT mdm.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN module_closure mc ON mdm.object_id = mc.module_id
),
target_deployment AS (
  SELECT object_id AS deployment_id
  FROM task_targets_deployment
  WHERE subject_id = 'task:fx01-cutover'
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.id
FROM services s
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = s.id
JOIN target_deployment td ON sd.object_id = td.deployment_id
JOIN service_implements_module sim ON sim.subject_id = s.id
JOIN module_closure mc ON sim.object_id = mc.module_id
ORDER BY s.id

WITH RECURSIVE pkg_deps(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx01-legacy'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mdm.subject_id FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN pkg_deps pd ON mdm.object_id = pd.module_id
)
SELECT s.id, sim.object_id as module, 
       CASE WHEN sim.object_id IN (SELECT module_id FROM pkg_deps) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as affected
FROM services s
JOIN service_implements_module sim ON sim.subject_id = s.id
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = s.id AND sd.object_id = 'deployment:fx01-production'
ORDER BY s.id
